Yes, we do have a price matching policy for price drops after purchase!
Price Matching Policy If the price of the same new item is reduced by Avocado or by an authorized retailer within 30 days after your purchase date, we will refund the difference to your original form of payment.
Important Details: What Qualifies:
This policy applies only to future price reductions that occur after your purchase
It does not apply to lower prices, promotions, or discounts that were already available at the time you placed your order
Requirements:
The item must be identical in model, size, and color
The item must be in stock at the time of the request
The lower price must be publicly advertised and verifiable
Only offers from authorized retailers qualify—we do not match prices from auction sites, marketplaces, resellers, or unauthorized retailers
How to Request:
You must contact our Customer Experience team within 30 days of your order date and provide proof of the lower advertised price. You'll receive an email confirmation upon approval, and the refunded amount may take several days to reflect based on your bank's processing times.
Promotions Shortly After Purchase:
If a promotion occurs shortly after a purchase and results in a lower price, you can contact Avocado to discuss potential refund options under the existing policies. Customers are encouraged to confirm eligibility directly with our customer support.
